verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Klaviyo's API lets you 'pull data from Klaviyo to … sync to other systems' (docs-18), with private-key access and SDKs (docs-1, docs-23). That implies a developer-driven route to extract data, but nothing shows a self-serve audience export, and the pricing page only mentions importing contacts. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve export (CSV or other open format) of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement/event history, and the suppression list, plus any independent or hands-on confirmation that a full export is possible.
